review.brief: Review RM33 tier 2 (charge FORM slice) on branch ft/RM33-MAG-18-manual-record-status, commits 4818d6c..9744a67. Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance - no HTML outside internal/gateway, no cross-module DB reads, charging.RequiredFieldsFor imported not re-derived (design.md D-Fields/D5); (2) every doc-pack convention, especially the i18n rule (both ES+EN for every user-facing key) and the no-client-side-JS rule with its now-FOUR recorded exceptions; (3) spec/tasks coverage - all 18 tasks, 8.4 owner-manual still open; (4) the integration tests assert design.md's AUTHORED Test Contract (A1-A8, B1-B4, C1-C7), not whatever the implementation happens to do - this is the highest-value check this round, see the two specific traps below; (5) read-heavy Performance-Profile compliance; (6) anti-gaming - no weakened criteria, no self-approved statuses. NO database objects were created or altered in this tier, so the database design gate does not apply. TRAP 1 (wave-2 history): a negative test asserting only 422 + writer-not-called passes off the spurious missing-status validation error and stays green even if the check it names is deleted. Every negative test must supply a valid status AND assert the specific i18n message. Verify this holds for all 8 Group A tests; two tests in wave 2 failed exactly this way. TRAP 2 (wave-4 history): C5's assertion was pinned to a literal class string and broke on Templ's generated trailing space. Check the remaining markup assertions are structural, not brittle on generated whitespace - and conversely that none was loosened so far it no longer tests C's claim. Also scrutinize task 8.5 specifically: a LEADER-authored fix (applyRawRequiredState) for a defect task 8.3's C3 test surfaced in ChargeCreate's 422/500 branches. It is leader-written code that no worker reviewed - verify it matches design.md D-Fields, that its fail-closed-to-DONE posture mirrors chargeEntryVMFromRawValues, and that its regression test genuinely fails without the fix.

rounds.scope_note: Reviewed the full gateway tier-2 diff (c639ff6..9744a67), not only the literal 4818d6c..9744a67 range named in the brief, since that narrower range excludes charges_vm.go/.templ files/catalog.go/app.js/input.templ that the brief's own 'files touched' list names as in scope.

findings.note: internal/gateway/handlers/charges.go: applyRawRequiredState and chargeEntryVMFromRawValues each re-implement a 'fail closed to DONE on unrecognized status' branch before calling charging.RequiredFieldsFor, which already returns the DONE set as its own default for any unrecognized status (internal/charging/validation.go RequiredFieldsFor's default case). Harmless duplication, explicitly documented as mirroring the module's own contract rather than relying on it implicitly; not a boundary or correctness issue.

rounds.trap_1_conclusion: HOLDS. All 8 Group A tests (A1-A8, charges_test.go:1890-2185) use validCreateForm() which sets status=IN_PROGRESS explicitly, and every negative-path subtest asserts the specific i18n error-message substring for the field under test (e.g. A2 asserts both the ended_at-required and battery-required ES strings, A4 asserts 'Estado inválido', A5/A6/A7/A8 each assert their own field's message) in addition to 422 + writer-not-called. Deleting the validation branch a given test names would remove that message from the body and turn the test red — verified by inspection for each of A1-A8.
rounds.trap_2_conclusion: HOLDS. C5 (charges_test.go:2486) now uses tagAttrsFor (a structural tag-boundary extractor) plus a regex tolerant of Templ's generated trailing space (`class="input[^"]*"`) that additionally pins the price input as a structural descendant of the compound label, strictly stronger than the substring check it replaced. C1-C4, C6, C7 all use tagAttrsFor or position-based (strings.Index) structural checks, none pinned to a full literal class string. No assertion was loosened past what its Test Contract letter requires.
rounds.task_8_5_conclusion: Matches design.md §D-Fields ('correct required attribute for the status being rendered, no flash-of-wrong-state before JS'). Fail-closed-to-DONE posture is byte-for-byte the same pattern as chargeEntryVMFromRawValues (both: unrecognized/empty status -> treat as DONE -> RequiredFieldsFor(DONE)). The regression test TestChargeCreate_DoneStatus_ErrorRerender_KeepsRequiredAttributes (charges_test.go:2586) submits status=DONE with a missing location_kind (unrelated field) causing the 422, then asserts ended_at/end_battery_pct still carry `required` in the re-rendered body — this would fail without applyRawRequiredState, since buildChargesPage's fresh-load Required* pair is computed from StatusInProgress and nothing else in the 422 branch would flip it to true. Genuine regression coverage.
rounds.notes: No blockers or majors. Boundaries clean (no HTML/DB outside gateway, RequiredFieldsFor imported not re-derived). i18n: all new/changed keys carry ES+EN, removed keys verified dead via grep. RD12/RD13 documented in AGENTS.md matching RD9/RD10 shape; cross-references in AGENTS.md and htmx-conventions.md both say 'exactly four' consistently. gofmt/go vet independently re-run clean. All 17 non-owner tasks match tasks.md; 8.5 is a genuine append, not a rescoping of 3.3. No performance regression (no new reads/writes added).

triage.F1: REJECTED (nit, no change made). charging.RequiredFieldsFor does default to the DONE set for an unrecognized status, so the branch is behaviorally redundant. Keeping it: it normalizes the STATUS VALUE at the call site rather than re-deriving the required-field RULE, so design.md D-Fields is not violated; it makes the fail-closed posture legible where the raw form value enters; and removing it would edit owner-verified code for zero behavior change, costing another full suite run. chargeEntryVMFromRawValues has carried the same branch since wave 2.
